VCR Inc. (2002). Challenge Registry Guide to Entity & Facility-Based Reporting, Version 2.2, November 2002, Section 9 Emission Factors (Tables 3-13), Canada's Climate Change Voluntary Challenge & Registry, Ottawa. Source URL printed in the full guide: http://www.vcr-mvr.ca/vcr-020.cfm.

EMISSION-FACTOR REFERENCE, NOT A TECHNOLOGY SOURCE: belongs in source-details_reference.csv (no id assigned; suggest vcr_2002_001). Only _factors.csv written (this 9-page file is Section 9 of the 54-page Challenge Registry guide, which is held as vcr_2002_challenge-registry-guide-reporting.pdf and sent down the no-data path because it repeats these tables). Locators are the guide page numbers shown in the guide contents (Table 3 p.35, Table 4 p.36, Table 7 p.38, Table 9 p.39, Table 13 pp.42-43). Written because it holds content that the 2026 ECCC Annex 6 does not: HISTORICAL provincial grid electricity emission factors 1990-2001 (kg CO2e/kWh, utility averages), coal-boiler CO2 factors by province and coal type for 1990-1994 and 1995-1999, and the 2002-vintage boiler factors (natural gas 1.891 kg/m3 etc., Environment Canada inventory 1990-2000). Fuel factors are superseded by eccc_2026_001. Not loaded: transport fuels (Table 5), transport/travel indirect factors (Tables 6, 12), tree sequestration (Table 8), agriculture (Tables 10-11). TRAPS: (1) The Table 4 text extraction has gaps; years were assigned from column position. New Brunswick (6 values, assigned 1994-1999) and Quebec (single value 0.0014, assigned 1997) are sparse rows whose year columns should be checked against the PDF image before use. Footnotes: values are utility averages not marginal, net generation, include imports where known, exclude purchased offsets; Yukon fiscal years start April. (2) Table 13 values precede their row labels in the text layout; assignment of rows to coal type follows reading order. The single CH4 value 0.000015 kg/kg and the N2O values apply to blocks of rows (utility boilers 0.00005, fluidized bed 0.00211, industrial/commercial 0.00011 kg/kg) and are listed once without a province. (3) Heating values are not given (per physical unit); natural gas kg/GJ conversion is stated only as multiply kg/m3 by 26.86.
